title: Public ticket Activity shows the description
summary: A new public ticket now shows its description in Activity, and the owner is told they can add an update. Tickets stay comment-only after submit.
changes: Show the ticket description as the first Activity item on a brand-new public ticket.
Tell the owner they can add an update (comment). Edit, close, and withdraw stay unavailable after submit.
affected_areas: APES CIC, Shelter, and Pet Care ticket show pages
version_rationale: Patch release: fills the empty public ticket Activity thread without changing owner permissions or ticket lifecycle.
validation: PHPUnit PublicTicketActivityTest covers a new public ticket, a ticket with no messages, the owner update hint, description remaining after a staff public reply, hidden internal notes, and staff seeing the description without the owner hint.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Owners still cannot edit, close, or withdraw a ticket after submit. That remains comment-only by design.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore Activity showing only later messages, without the opening description or owner update hint.
provenance: Public ticket Activity description fix for issue #150, pull request #201.
